claude._comment: Proxy wrapper: for a claude that must reach the API through a proxy, point command at a launcher/wrapper script (this cc) that exports the proxy - and any auth - inside itself before exec'ing claude. NEVER put a real token or credential in this file: it is copied into a gitignored local config, but secrets belong only in the launcher script, never here. The codex entry below shows the alternative of injecting the proxy via env; keep those values secret-free too.

gateway._comment: Optional quota block: how to read THIS identity's balance, for reminders only. command must print JSON and key must select this lane's entry in it; quota-axi cannot see a gateway account, and nothing here ever selects a launch identity. See docs/configuration.md 'Custom quota sources'.
